improvement_trail.effect: queues appear (13 vs 38 at the main approach); cohort arrivals preserved (265, 0 teleports)

finding: Trajectory- and junction-level validation is strong (speed MAE 3.0 m/s, per-vehicle tt errors 1-9 s, calibrated discharge nABC 11.8%), but FREE-RUNNING network-level flow validation is limited by single-flight demand observability: several boundary streets' B inflows are not inferable from A coverage. This is precisely the fragmentation limitation the calibration paper cites as motivation for PER-CYCLE reinitialization - which our Step-3 experiment protocol uses.
conclusion: Twin usable for per-cycle/short-horizon causal experiments (validated regime); free-running long-horizon network forecasting declared out of validated scope.
